name: cloud-logging-cross-project-configuration
description: >- Configure and troubleshoot Google Cloud cross-project centralized logging and read-time aggregation. Use when: - Setting up log routing from multiple projects/folders/organizations to a central log bucket. - Creating cross-project log sinks and configuring central log buckets. - Troubleshooting cross-project routing. Don't use for single-project basic configurations.
author: google
summary_zh: 用于配置和排查 Google Cloud 跨项目集中日志路由与读取聚合，适合多项目统一收集和管理日志。
